description: Season Cache for Minecraft 26.2. Port of ItsThatNova's Season Cache (MIT).

mods.name: Seasonal Terrain
mods.description: Makes the world follow Serene Seasons. Seasonal snow and ice on loaded chunks, and season colors and snow on Distant Horizons terrain, with no shader needed.

releases.notes:
Season Cache and Seasonal LODs (ssdh) are now one jar. Remove ssdh26 from the pack. Mod id is still seasoncache.

Adds: season colors on far Distant Horizons terrain, and a no-shader snow tint for far terrain (prototype, not yet seen working in game, see /ssdh snow). Distant Horizons is optional. Fixes the unread client event queue growing forever. Includes 26.2.4 (chunk blocking fix) and 26.2.3 (seasonal snow block).

Tested: server boots clean on a dev server. The client LOD code was built against DH 3.3.2 but NOT run. See CHANGELOG.md.

mods.name: Season Cache
mods.description: Keeps snow and ice in sync with Serene Seasons. Removes snow in spring, places it in winter, and drives LOD shader snow coverage for Nova Reimagined and Distant Horizons.

releases.notes:
Stops the server thread freezing on chunk loads. Biome reads for unloaded chunks use the generator's noise. The ice shoreline check treats an unloaded neighbor as air. Sweep edits skip shape updates at a chunk edge next to an unloaded chunk.

Builds on 26.2.3 (seasonal snow block). See CHANGELOG.md.

Tested: boots on a dev server and derives rules for 289 chunks with no errors. The sweep edit paths were NOT run, because a dev server has no player. Not fixed: Ultimate Map Atlases has the same kind of blocking call.

mods.name: Season Cache
mods.description: Keeps snow and ice in sync with Serene Seasons. Removes snow in spring, places it in winter, and drives LOD shader snow coverage for Nova Reimagined and Distant Horizons.

releases.notes:
Seasonal snow is now its own block (seasoncache:seasonal_snow), a copy of vanilla snow. Season-change removal deletes only that block, including on leaves and roofs. Vanilla snow is never touched. Also fixes the snow_placement_blacklist tag path and the off-by-one in topY.

Snow that fell before this version is vanilla snow. Run /seasoncache legacysweep once to clear it. The mod must be on the client too.

Does not fix the blocking chunk loads in UnloadedChunkCoverageBuilder and ChunkSeasonReconciler.isShorelineAdjacent. See CHANGELOG.md.
